video_title: Josh Hart on post-championship life, reveals plans for biggest live "Roommates Show" yet

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the early days and growth of the Roommates Show
quotes.excerpt: we didn't really have like a goal in mind. We were just like, let's start it
quotes.quote: We started it and didn't really know what the trajectory was going to be. We didn't really have like a goal in mind. We were just like, let's start it and just see if anything comes of it. Obviously, two and a half years later, three seasons in, it's definitely grown a little bit bigger than we thought it was going to be, but it's been a fun process. Not every day is fun, it's very up and down, as many of the Playmaker and everyone else would probably tell you in terms of getting episodes recorded sometimes, but it's been a fun process.

quotes.speaker: Matt Hillman
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt Hillman on the show's growth and tangible value for players
quotes.excerpt: it's really cool for the guys to have like a tangible piece of IP
quotes.quote: It's grown beyond what we thought it would be and I think it's really cool for the guys to have like a tangible piece of IP that can also benefit from all of the work that they do on the court. We feel it in the show's growth, we feel it in the listenership, we feel it in the sponsorship, we certainly feel it in the demand for live events. So, it's just cool to have this thing that we're all building together that can really benefit from all the work that they do.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the rapid sell-out of the live show at Randall's Island
quotes.excerpt: that sold out extremely quickly and I think we had at one point 27,000 people in the queue
quotes.quote: We did a live show at MSG and I think that held like 6,000 people, but that sold out extremely quickly and I think we had at one point 27,000 people in the queue to buy tickets. So, obviously there has been a boom there. We normally do it at Central Park, the last two years we've done it at Central Park, and I think that holds roughly 4,100 or 4,200, and we did it this year and that's kind of sold out in 90 seconds. So, we were like, what can we do? So, we're changing the venue to Randall's Island and we'll be able to host more people.

quotes.speaker: Matt Hillman
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt Hillman and Josh Hart on the overwhelming fan demand for the live show
quotes.excerpt: there was nothing but excitement across the board

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Hillman
text_blocks.text: I think it was like 85-90% of the people that were like, let's do it, let's say at Randall's. So, we were trying to decide how we wanted to approach it because obviously it's a little bit of a different experience than Central Park and the last thing that you want is people to think they bought something for one thing and then they get something else. But there was nothing but excitement across the board and so we're excited to give them an even better experience.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: There were like 10,000 people on the waitlist and I think Matt and Jalen and all them can probably say what percent of it, but I think it was probably 70% of the people on that waitlist were like, yeah, we're good. You find somewhere and we'll do it.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on whether the players' wives will return to the show
quotes.excerpt: they had their time. I mean, maybe, I don't know, we haven't really talked about it
quotes.quote: They had their time. I mean, maybe, I don't know, we haven't really talked about too much of what we're going to do, but we might bring them out on stage, we'll see.

quotes.speaker: Matt Hillman
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt Hillman on the chaotic nature of life after winning a championship
quotes.excerpt: you never really hear about what happens after the win
quotes.quote: I think Josh probably feels the same way, but it's probably the funnest but also most chaotic personal mix of personal and professional time really ever, because the one thing that caught me by surprise is you never really hear about what happens after the win. You could just kind of think it's all celebrations and fun, but I'll be honest, I don't think they got to really even enjoy it till multiple, multiple weeks after, probably when he got to Europe. And then even when he got back to Europe, he had an equally crazy week with Fanatics Fest and World Cup and all these appearances.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on his busy summer schedule and finding time to relax
quotes.excerpt: I think I'm doing like two or three brand stuff, but all of those are in the Hamptons
quotes.quote: I went to two, I went to Donovan and Coco's wedding and then we just got back from Kat and Jordan's wedding. I've kind of told everybody I'm doing like two or three brand stuff, but all of those are in the Hamptons, so I'm just like, August is kind of my time to just kind of work out, kind of get away from the stuff, but been able to relax. We went to Bordeaux, Capri, and Rome, so got a little bit of time away.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on discussing roster changes on the podcast
quotes.excerpt: we're definitely going to talk about it, especially at that point when training camp is right around the corner
quotes.quote: We're definitely going to talk about it, especially at that point when training camp is right around the corner. So, we'll for sure talk about it, talk about obviously Mitchell's departure and I'm sure the Toronto trade is probably going to go through now and Giannis stuff. So, we'll definitely talk about all that stuff then and what to look forward to and etc.

quotes.speaker: Matt Hillman
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt Hillman on the nerves of performing in front of a live audience
quotes.excerpt: it is very different going out and playing in front of 20,000 people
quotes.quote: I don't know, I feel like it's very different going out and playing in front of 20,000 people, which is what he's done his whole career. Again, Josh, not trying to speak for you, but going out and doing something like this and entertaining, it's just doing it in a different way. At least for all, I guess I'll just speak for myself, I think it is definitely a little bit nerve-wracking the moment before you go out. But then once you go out, we know we have each other and like you said, we've done it so many times, you sort of get into that flow where it does just kind of feel like a studio episode.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the anxiety of the post-championship live show
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't say I was nervous but I was more anxious because obviously that got aired on ESPN
quotes.quote: The live show after the championship, that one, I wouldn't say I was nervous but I was more anxious because obviously that got aired on ESPN the night before. So, you're sitting there like, it's just different because it's not just like a fun like block party where you're able to just kind of have fun and do it like you got to do but you got to stick to a schedule. So, it's like you're trying to get these things, we got Stephen A., Stephen A. keeps just keeps talking. So, not nervousness, not really too much anymore.

quotes.speaker: Matt Hillman
quotes.summary_phrase: Matt Hillman on the strategy for evolving the Roommates Show
quotes.excerpt: we're always trying to innovate and do different things
quotes.quote: We're always trying to innovate and do different things, whether it's new types of guests that expose us to different audiences or different formats and segments that bring out new elements. Obviously, this past season we did like a Thanksgiving episode where we had teammates on and we did a Christmas episode with the wives, so stuff like that's really fun. I will say I think early on when the show was new and Josh and Jalen were still growing a little bit more in their careers, we felt like we had a lot of guests on to help grow the show. I think one thing that changed this year is we felt very confident without having guests and trusting in the fact that people want to listen to the three of us banter and the two of them talk about what they're seeing on the court during the season.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the team's private celebrations after winning the championship
quotes.excerpt: we were celebrating almost every night and enjoying each other's company
quotes.quote: We were celebrating almost every night and enjoying each other's company. You kind of always do that at the end of the year. Last year we did the same thing in terms of obviously we lost and it kind of came out like, oh we were partying and then Tibs got fired like the next day or something like that or the day before. But it's like you always want to go out and celebrate at the end of every year like with that team because at the end of the day like that team in its entirety is never going to be back together. You're not going to have that same locker room, guys are going to go in, guys are going to go out. So, we had a bunch of times where we were able to go out and celebrate as a team and as a whole and I'll leave those details out for another day.
